subject.title: feat(agents): add multi-pass context compaction with progress tracking

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR as the core path for multi-pass/pre-compaction pruning, or should the unintegrated multi-pass work be deferred to the existing compaction architecture issue?
rationale: The branch now mixes narrow production fixes with unintegrated multi-pass scaffolding on a session-state-sensitive core path, and current related issues already mark the broader architecture as a maintainer product decision.

options.title: Narrow to production-safe compaction fixes
options.body: Require the branch to fix the replay and cut-point blockers, prove the real compaction path, and defer unintegrated multi-pass architecture until maintainers sponsor it.

options.title: Sponsor full core multi-pass architecture
options.body: Maintain the broader direction but require explicit integration, upgrade/session-state proof, and a clean design decision against https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/58398 before merge.

options.title: Pause or close in favor of the architecture issue
options.body: Close or park this branch if maintainers want the multi-layer compaction design settled before accepting partial core scaffolding.

recommendation.title: Narrow to production-safe compaction fixes
recommendation.body: Require the branch to fix the replay and cut-point blockers, prove the real compaction path, and defer unintegrated multi-pass architecture until maintainers sponsor it.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses core compaction, session-state, and product architecture surfaces where recent history and related review context point to this owner path.
